title: Lace Larrabee: White Trash Cinderella
overview: You may have seen Lace Larrabee on America’s Got Talent, but buckle up and get ready for Lace unleashed! Her debut album, “White Trash Cinderella,” showcases Lace’s sharp, honest and sometimes dark humor. Lace digs into topics from serial killers to surviving beauty pageants. Keep your eye on this hilarious Southern Belle - she’s blazing a path for comedic success.
